name: Wrapped iTRY
oneLiner: wiTRY is a Brix staking wrapper that accrues yield over iTRY, with exposure to Turkish-lira money-market funds and local TRY instruments.
collateral: iTRY deposited into the Brix staking wrapper, backed by regulated Turkish-lira money-market funds and related TRY cash/liquidity instruments
pegMechanism: wiTRY appreciates against iTRY as fund yield is minted into the staking contract and vests over time; users can unstake through a cooldown or use Fast Redeem for a fee, while final TRY exposure inherits iTRY issuer and local-currency risk

mechanismArchetypeReview.rationale: Brix backing documentation identifies DLF tokens representing a regulated basket of Turkish money-market funds behind iTRY. Staking documentation identifies wiTRY as ERC-4626 shares in deposited iTRY, appreciating as protocol rewards accrue. With iTRY admitted as a tracked fixed-TRY parent, wiTRY is a savings-passthrough variant excluded from parent-inclusive supply aggregates. Both use the tbill archetype, with NAV accrual only on wiTRY; no archetypeOverride is required. Fund look-through remains unresolved at the parent, and the child retains its direct wrapper claim.
